- [LCDB.7.9] **A rule-wide window is warned about.** When `cooldown` sits on
  a rule whose activation key is empty ([LCDB.3.3.3]) — every
  bound fact contributes nothing, so the rule has one window for all its
  activations ([LCDB.7.2]) — the compiler must emit the warning
  `DS_VALIDATE_RULE_WIDE_RATE_WINDOW`, naming the rule. It is a warning, not a
  refusal: the program compiles and the rule-wide window is what it gets.
